name: Sankyo Frontier
verdict: Sankyo Frontier Co., Ltd., a Tokyo-listed unit-house maker majority-held by the Nagatsuma family's unlisted vehicle Kazuyuki Kosan. Nothing found.
aliases: 三協フロンテア株式会社
note: Kit sponsor (front, right collarbone) of Kashiwa Reysol 2026-27 per https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/goods/202627-4.html ; the company also holds the club's stadium naming rights (三協フロンテア柏スタジアム). Rating note: Kazuyuki Kosan (50.54%) is 100% owned by the Nagatsuma family per the securities report; private family control, no state or fund involvement found.
